title: A Hereditary Property of Cutting Plane Procedures
summary: Let $K'$ denote the closure of a convex set $K$ under a given cutting-plane procedure. The procedure satisfies the \emph{hereditary property} if $F' = K' \cap F$ for every face $F$ of $K$. The property underlies inductive proofs of finite-rank and the polyhedrality of closures, and it is an admissibility requirement in abstract frameworks for cutting-plane procedures. Yet, it has not been studied systematically across well-known cutting-plane procedures. We establish two sufficient conditions for the property.
